offer.say: Okay so the mitten tree. Every mitten over a month old goes on a real tree in the lobby, then the school gets them in January. Gus did it every year. I want ours to be better than Gus's. Is that disrespectful? It feels disrespectful. I still want it.

options.text: Why mittens? Why not sell them?
Can we put Doris's antlers on the tree?

why.say: Sell them? To who? The mittens have, like, a destiny. Last year a kid found his own mitten on the tree and cried. I almost cried. Earl actually cried, but he says it was the cold.

options.text: You've convinced me. Let's do it.

cheek.say: Earl allows the antlers on Doris. He does not allow the antlers off Doris. Those are her antlers now. But yes, it'd look amazing.

options.text: Fine, no antlers. Let's do it anyway.

decline.say: Next year Gus wins again. From Florida. He'll know. He'll send a postcard with a flamingo looking smug.

accepted.say: Yes! First the crate. Wear gloves. There's a retainer in there and it's been there since I started.

options.text: The lobby's too sticky for a tree right now.
Tree's up. Just waiting for the Christmas skate.

p_sort.say: The socks aren't mittens. I know. I want to put them on anyway. Foot mittens.

p_clean.say: It's the Haverstock. Fourteen marshmallows a cup means the floor is basically candy.

p_skate.say: Big Gord's doing Santa. He's going to shout his slogan at the tree. Every year. Every tree.

complete.say: Best tree in the valley. Harlow Falls has a plastic one. HARLOW FALLS HAS A PLASTIC ONE. A kid found her mitten and her mum took a photo. Okay. Last thing. Which mitten goes on top?

options.text: The red CMC with the woollen cuff. It's the fanciest.
The one from truss 3, if you can reach it.

c_red.say: Classic. CMC would want this. CMC would apologise for how much it wants this.

c_truss.say: The 1999 hat trick mitten? Nobody can reach it. That's the point, isn't it. A star you can't reach. Oh, that's deep. I'll leave a gap at the top.

c_sock.say: YES. Foot mitten on top. Earl's going to hate it. Earl's going to love it. He'll never say which.

done.say: Next year I'm doing two trees. Don't stop me.
